resources.string: SHARE YOUR SCREEN OR SOUND / PREVIEW
A separate Mac display, an iPhone screen, or music on your TV. A new sender connection can replace the current session.
Open playback to connect, or turn on Background listening.
Reconnect controls to check the receiver. Your sender may still be connected.
Connected · waiting for video or audio
The existing connection is kept. Background discovery is off.
Choose TVCompanion in your Apple device’s AirPlay picker.
Open playback to retry. If the connection fails again, reconnect from your Apple device.
The receiver did not reply in time. Check its status before trying again.
The receiver is finishing another action. Try again when it is ready.
These receiver controls are incompatible. Update the app before retrying.
Mac display: Control Center → Screen Mirroring → TVCompanion. Choose mirroring or an extended display on your Mac.
iPhone / iPad: Control Center → Screen Mirroring → TVCompanion.
Music / Spotify: choose TVCompanion in the AirPlay audio picker. Screen Mirroring is not needed.
Stay discoverable and accept a connection with playback closed.
Keep the current connection when you leave. When off, leaving playback ends that session.
Continue sound while video is hidden or another TV app is open, subject to audio focus.
Turn on Keep session connected to allow background audio. A saved On choice stays inactive until then.
Open playback for a new video session when Android permits. Music alone stays in the background.
Options apply until the receiver service exits. Listening does not start after reboot. Stop AirPlay ends the connection and turns listening off.

Mirroring: 720p / 30 fps with audio. In-app YouTube HLS video is experimental; app/DRM compatibility varies. Connect on the same trusted local network. Spotify uses AirPlay audio; Spotify Connect is not included.
Native source notices were not prepared for this build.
Allow notifications for TVCompanion to enable Background listening. Open playback still works without it.
Video can continue, but sound is unavailable or held by another app.
The session is connected with video hidden. Open playback to view it.
This video requires content protection that this receiver does not support. Use the service’s supported TV app or receiver.
This app’s video format or AirPlay path is unsupported. Mirroring and AirPlay audio are separate features.
App video could not load or play. Reconnect from the sender; a format, network or authorization error may be involved.
720p / 30 fps mirroring with audio. Connect on the same trusted local network. This receiver does not advertise in-app video playback.
